title: Restriction property of module cohomology maps
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $p\in\mathbb N$. For every open subset $U\subseteq Y$, with inclusion $j:U\to Y$, there exists a module isomorphism $\kappa:G|_U\to j^*G$ between restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] and tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] such that $H^p(U,\kappa)\circ\rho^*=\eta^*$ [pqf-def-cohomology] [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Here $\rho:G\to j_*(G|_U)$ is the restriction-adjunction unit and $\eta:G\to j_*j^*G$ is the unit of the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction.

proof.text: Choose the isomorphism from Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq between restrictAdjunction and the chosen tensorPullback adjunction. Its unit compatibility identifies the restriction unit followed by pushforward of its hom with the chosen tensor unit.
Apply target-isomorphism naturality to the restriction unit and the chosen isomorphism; rewrite its composite h-map by the unit equation. This is exactly the unchanged conclusion.

theorem moduleCohomologyFMap_basic_restriction {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ (U : Y.Opens),
      ∃ κ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G ≅ (tensorPullback U.ι).obj G,
        moduleCohomologyFMap U.ι ((restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app G) p ≫
            (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map
              (((U : Scheme).toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology p).map κ.hom) =
          moduleCohomologyFMap U.ι
            ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction U.ι)).unit.app G) p
